response: {"thought": "語意層沒有對應到「配送天數」與日期範圍，我先抽樣 shipments 與 orders 的時間欄位格式，確認天數計算與季度篩選的方式。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"queries": ["SELECT s.shipment_id, s.order_id, s.carrier, s.shipped_ts, s.delivered_ts, o.order_ts FROM shipments s LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id LIMIT 10", "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(delivered_ts IS NULL) AS null_delivered, SUM(shipped_ts IS NULL) AS null_shipped, MIN(shipped_ts) AS min_shipped, MAX(shipped_ts) AS max_shipped FROM shipments"]}}
